question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneous spelling is** 'Fabulus'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Fabulus**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Fabulous**'. • It means** 'very good; excellent'. **(बहुत अच्‍छा; उच्‍च कोटि का) • *Example: I had a **fabulous** time.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Farther**: (at) a distance. (दूर; आगे) • **Fasting**: abstinence from food or drink or both for health, ritualistic, religious, or ethical purposes. (स्वास्थ्य, कर्मकांड, धार्मिक या नैतिक उद्देश्यों के लिए भोजन या पेय या दोनों से परहेज) • **Further**: more; to a greater degree. (कुछ या कोई और, और कोई; इससे अधिक) 3f:Ta82, The correct answer is '**don't**'.
